answer: Beacon-whispered forge gates with prism review. Each epoch the on-chain beacon whispers a fresh seed into a public forge; would-be agents must forge a stake-backed commitment to that unpredictable seed inside a short window, so identities cannot be precomputed offline. Admissions are then examined through a prism of randomized established-peer shards, each approving only claims it can verify. A sybil running M personas must fund M stakes and pass M prism reviews every epoch, so attack cost grows linearly in M while payoff per persona collapses to zero.
